body: I just want to add that this is still an issue in 0.4.0.

repository.name: glsl-to-spirv
repository.description: Fork of (deprecated) glsl-to-spirv for use in Bevy while we wait for a pure rust shader compiler

body:
The key of course is in this line of building `bevy-glsl-to-spirv`:
```
thread 'main' panicked at 'Missing target support i686-pc-windows-msvc'
```

We can see in https://github.com/cart/glsl-to-spirv/blob/df5c66339906bd465b714014bc63cdeaccb55061/build/build.rs that the build script only supports explicitly specified platforms, and for good reason: it needs to use the appropriate platform-specific libraries. This is already a good indication of where the problem lies - there are no `.lib` files for i686 toolchains.

We can see from https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang/releases/tag/master-tot that there are no official 32-bit builds, so I submitted a PR to add the libraries (cart/glsl-to-spirv#6).

If you need to make some i686 builds right now, you can temporarily modify `bevy` to use my fork by modifying `bevy/crates/bevy_render/Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[target.'cfg(all(not(target_os = "ios"), not(target_arch = "wasm32"), not(all(target_arch = "aarch64", target_os = "macos"))))'.dependencies]
bevy-glsl-to-spirv = { git = "https://github.com/GrygrFlzr/glsl-to-spirv", version = "0.2.0" }
```

This works for 32_bit, but breaks 64:
